subject: Bharatanatyam (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: History of Indian Dance
topics: A brief history of Indian dance

chapters.name: Themes in Bharatanatyam
topics: Cosmic dance of Siva and Nataraja; Mahishasura Mardini; Ganesha

chapters.name: History of Bharatanatyam
topics: Tanjore quartet and the present repertoire

chapters.name: Bharatanatyam Repertoire
topics: Pushpanjali, mallari, kautuvam, alarippu, jatiswaram, shabdam, varnam, keertanam, padam, ashtapadi, javali, thillana

chapters.name: Distinctive Aspects of Bharatanatyam
topics: Costume and jewellery, language and music, technique, basic posture

chapters.name: Positions and Body Movements
topics: Stretching and flexing of body parts

chapters.name: Adavus in Trikala
topics: Tattu, nattu, ta tei tei ta, kudittu mettu, tei ya teiyi, tat tei ta ha, tat tei tam, kattu and utplavana, mandi, sarukkai adavus

chapters.name: Tala
topics: Adi and rupaka talam with hastakriya; adavu syllables in trikala
